used_propositions: Billing records show billed_name Helion Robotics Limited.
The master services agreement document names Helion Robotics Ltd. as the counterparty.
Commercial notes explicitly state that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity.

Commercial notes describe Helion Robotics Ltd as the CRM operating name and Helion Robotics Limited as the name used on invoices and Companies House, presenting two name forms across operational contexts.
support_claim: Although commercial notes assert that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, an unresolved_preservation proposition preserves differing name forms tied to the contract versus billing referents, so the identity judgment cannot be closed.
